title: Expose protected storage status and stateless prompt handoff
verify: Independent auth/security verification covers Boss/Engineer/Consultant, invalid/disabled session, exact OpenAPI/response/no-store behavior, safe aggregation failure, two-Account consumer isolation, fresh-load reappearance, and zero mutation surface.
evidence_required: FT-015-AC-004 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: no protected Farm storage-status boundary exists for the future FT-016 consumer; alternative proof: route/OpenAPI preflight absence plus GREEN exact PhotoStorageStatus and owner/dependency inspection; decisive comparison: registered route/schema and absence of duplicate FT-016 authority; artifact: API transcript under .tasks/TASK-066-T3-FT-015-W2/.

FT-015-AC-006 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: FT-015 intentionally has no backend prompt-action lifecycle to invoke before the read contract exists; alternative proof: GREEN two-Account consumer model closes acknowledge/dismiss only locally while repeated GET stays eligible and no mutation route/table/event/sync change exists; decisive comparison: response sequence, account-local state, route/schema scan, and unchanged local_only; artifact: consumer transcript.
purpose: Publish the Photo-Intake-owned status as one authenticated Farm-wide read and prove FT-016 can keep prompt actions transient without acquiring backend storage/sync authority.
success_outcome: GET /api/photos/storage-status returns the exact no-store PhotoStorageStatus for any active Farm member, maps aggregation failure safely, exposes no mutation route/state, and supports independent transient acknowledge/dismiss behavior for multiple Accounts with fresh-request reappearance.
anti_goals: Do not create POST/PATCH/DELETE prompt routes, persistence, Timeline events, cooldowns, episodes, uploads, server fields, or UI code.
Do not require PlantAccessGrant or redefine the aggregation.
constraints: Resolve existing cookie ActorContext and active Account/FarmMembership; the route is Farm-wide and Plant-independent.
Response has only farm_id, literal local_only, total, literal threshold, and eligibility; Cache-Control is no-store.
Consumer proof may use a deterministic model/harness, not a new frontend scaffold.
invariants: Prompt actions never write or change sync authority.
FT-016 may render/compose but not redefine the status contract.
verification_targets: FT-015-AC-006: two-Account transient actions, reload reappearance, no mutation route/state/event, and unchanged local_only.

forbidden_scope: Svelte/PWA/frontend, prompt persistence/migration, upload/server/sync lifecycle, Plant permission redesign, or agent context.
stop_conditions: A protected Farm-wide read cannot reuse current ActorContext without a new auth decision.
Consumer semantics require any backend write or frontend scaffold.
An error requires a new public envelope or status outside the accepted contract.
